methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of thermal pouch laminators. All five non-null prices were re-confirmed against the cited pages and required no correction: Fellowes Saturn3i 125 $219.99 (laminator.com), Fellowes Jupiter2 125 $358.76 (mybinding.com), Swingline GBC Fusion 3000L $203.29 (mybinding.com), GBC Fusion 1000L $50.16 (gbc.com), Scotch PRO TL906 $42.99 (mybinding.com). One product was dropped: the 'Bonsaii L307-A' was a substitution for a non-existent 'L306-A' and could not itself be verified (source page returned repeated HTTP 500s; nearly every spec was null), so it was removed rather than retained on faith. Fields that were the draft's own range-midpoint estimates were nulled (Amazon Basics, Crenova, Blusmart warm-up times) per null-beats-a-guess. Crenova's roller count was nulled because the manufacturer page does not state it (draft over-claimed '2-roller design'). Widths are in inches, pouch thickness in mil (micron converted, ~125 micron ~ 5 mil), warm-up in minutes (40 sec = 0.7), speed in inches/minute. Booleans: hot_and_cold = documented support for both thermal and cold/pressure-sensitive pouches; jam_release_lever = documented manual jam-release/reverse mechanism; auto_shutoff = documented idle power-off. Web search was unavailable this session; verification was by direct page fetch. Two entries (Scotch TL901X primary page, Blusmart) could not be re-fetched (transient network / retailer bot-challenge) and rest on the draft's cited figures with booleans/guessed specs left null. All accessedAt 2026-08-16.
